title: Jingle Bells · Kiểu 2
heard: Kiểu 1: "tôi lấy bản 3a" (I take 3a): Kiểu 1 locked at 3a, Kiểu 2 (the Rhodes) next
about: v1a: ballad-human as it is (the Rhodes: the tune's last phrase as the intro, then the verses over the deep bass, the rolling pairs breathing with each phrase, the carol's chords coloured as pop ballads colour them, our soft pad far under it; 72 bpm, the 0.8 s room), with the quick, tidy ending the user chose in Piano nỉ and kept in Kiểu 1 (the last chord let go two beats on), its tail made for the Rhodes: the Rhodes and the pad hold on where the upright dies away, so the mix fades over 2 s and ends when the sound is 50 dB down, its last chord dying as Kiểu 1's did (remixed from 1a's parts: from 5 to 22 dB down over its last 2 s; the 1 s fade cut it from 9 dB down in 0.6 s). sfizz is mended (sampled.yml).
